verdicts.flaw_b: It abandons the kolomyika meter (7–9 syllables) and uses filler lines and nonsense phrases («Пузо — наче в тому горі», «святий дух, моя») to get rhymes.

verdicts.flaw_a: Commentary is appended after the poem, and the poem has a garbled word ("потемнїї"). The ending explains the meaning ("Він, мабуть, цього й хотів") and the mid-poem lines are prosaic filler.
